name: Cox's Bazar
subtitle: Sea and sunsets
description: Enjoy a long sandy beach, sea views, and beautiful sunsets. Stroll along the world's longest natural sea beach and experience local coastal hospitality.

name: Sajek Valley
subtitle: Hills and clouds
description: Explore green hills, cloud-filled valleys, and scenic viewpoints. Nestled among the hill tracts, enjoy picturesque sunrises with clouds below your feet.

name: Sundarbans
subtitle: Mangrove forest
description: Discover the famous mangrove forest and its rich natural environment. Home of the majestic Royal Bengal Tiger, spotted deer, and scenic waterways.

name: Sreemangal
subtitle: Tea capital
description: Wander through rolling green tea gardens, Lawachara National Park, and taste the world-famous seven-layer tea in the serene countryside.

name: Saint Martin's Island
subtitle: Coral reef & blue water
description: Explore Bangladesh's only coral island, with pristine turquoise water, coconut groves, and calm island breezes.
